instrument_family_label: instrument_family derived from immutable acquisition-platform metadata and distinct from sensor_family
canonical_algorithm: StratifiedGroupKFold with shuffle true and repeat seed

T1.train: outer folds other than test fold within station
requirements: all supported classes retained in output

T3_ZS.train_source: outer-training masters within station and instrument not equal held instrument
T3_ZS.test_target: outer-test masters within station and instrument equal held instrument
requirements: held instrument absent from all fitting roles
outer-test masters absent from all fitting roles
test labels absent from selection calibration and stopping

preprocessing_variants.universal: PP-U-MIN PP-U-SG or PP-U-ARPLS receives no held-unit metadata beyond exclusion
preprocessing_variants.family_aware: PP-FAMILY-SRC receives the held unit platform-family identifier but no held-unit spectra or statistics
preprocessing_variants.qc_adaptive: PP-QC-SRC receives only the current row permitted QC vector through a source-frozen gate

T4_OPEN.blank_policy: blank remains a known operational class

inner_selection.fallback: master-grouped inner CV when fewer than two supported pseudo-domains exist

preprocessing_policy_selection.shared_source_pseudo_domains: The same leave-one-supported-source-instrument-out partitions used for model development are reused without access to outer-test rows.
preprocessing_policy_selection.policy_model_nesting: Preprocessing-policy selection and estimator hyperparameter selection have separate hashes and roles. Both remain inside outer source training.
preprocessing_policy_selection.family_support_resolution: Before P03 outcomes P02 applies the metadata-only support rule in preprocessing_policy_contract.json and writes supported unsupported and fallback rows for every outer domain.
preprocessing_policy_selection.qc_threshold_resolution: For each outer source-training partition registered QC quantiles are computed from source-training rows only; gate ranking uses source pseudo-domain validation only.
preprocessing_policy_selection.evaluation_lock: A policy mapping or QC gate is frozen before any prediction on its corresponding outer-test rows.

adaptation_regimes.UDA: unlabeled target intensities from disjoint adaptation masters; labels and pair IDs hidden
adaptation_regimes.paired_calibration: target-source pair IDs from disjoint calibration masters allowed
adaptation_regimes.few_shot: k labelled target masters per class from disjoint calibration masters

fixed_source_only.target_access: current spectrum only for deterministic row-local transformation

row_local_qc_source_only.target_access: permitted current-row QC only; no target batch summaries

unlabeled_target_adaptation.target_access: disjoint unlabeled adaptation masters for registered model adaptation; preprocessing remains source-frozen in v1

paired_calibration.target_access: disjoint paired calibration masters and pair IDs for registered model calibration; preprocessing remains source-frozen in v1

supervised_few_shot.target_access: disjoint labelled calibration masters for registered model fitting; no v1 target-selected preprocessing
